items.text: Washington (early week, estimated Mon report): DNP - WR Treylon Burks (foot), C Lucas Patrick (concussion, in protocol), TE Colson Yankoff (knee). Limited - TE Chig Okonkwo (hip), DT Shy Tuttle (shoulder). Full - QB Jayden Daniels (left/non-throwing elbow). IR/season - WR Terry McLaurin, WR Jaylin Lane, DT Daron Payne, DT Javon Kinlaw, LB Leo Chenal; IR - RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin); LT Laremy Tunsil out until ~December. Jayden Daniels expected to start.

NY Giants (early week, estimated Mon report): Limited - QB J.J. McCarthy (hip pointer from Wk9; Harbaugh: 'it does look like he's going to play'), RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring, missed Wk9, expected full go), WR Darnell Mooney (chest), OLB Abdul Carter (knee/back), LB Malik Harrison (groin). Full - WR Malik Nabers, OT Andrew Thomas, OT Jermaine Eluemunor. IR - QB Jaxson Dart (knee, regular season), EDGE Brian Burns and LB Tremaine Edmunds (season), RB Tyrone Tracy Jr.
NYG QB McCarthy (hip pointer) on track to play Thursday.
items.source: CBS Sports (McCarthy on track for TNF, Nov 9)
